title: Florida v. Jardines (2013)
key_points: Holding: Bringing a drug-sniffing dog onto a home's front porch to investigate is a search requiring a warrant.
officer_notes: Scenario: On a tip, you walk a K-9 to the front door of a house and the dog alerts.
Takeaway: The home's curtilage is protected; use the tip to build probable cause for a warrant.
